geometry_edits.rationale: Keep the protected section controller in ancestry but change its section family from a jagged sawtooth to a folded profile that better matches the visible neighborhood-living massing.
Reduce arbitrary stepping and improve section continuity without erasing the carved void below.
Orient the section to reinforce the dominant bar-like reading and the public edge response.

graph_edits.rationale: Replace the sawtooth profile with a calmer continuous roof/section family to better support the neighborhood-living section contract while preserving the carved primary mass ancestry.
Use a folded section family instead of a repetitive sawtooth to keep the dominant gesture but improve section continuity and program fit.
Align the profile to the short axis so the mass reads as a coherent low-rise neighbor building with a clearer long edge and public threshold.

rationale: The candidate reads as one dominant carved-and-stepped mass with a believable courtyard/void and a reasonably clear hierarchy. It responds to the parcel more coherently than a pure bounding-box fill, and the blue frontage is answered by an open seam/undercut rather than a sealed edge. The silhouette is somewhat repetitive and sawtooth-like, but still coherent across views and not visibly self-colliding. Programmatically it can plausibly support neighborhood living with public ground and upper mass, though the section is only moderately convincing and leans a bit too much toward sculpted step-massing rather than a calm inhabited section.

reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Stacked, legible massing with a clear lower datum and an articulated upper order while keeping a usable ground condition.
